question: student hits an error, then sits for 2 minutes, scrolls up, scrolls down, doesn't type. guide v2 says "stuck" but "stuck" also covers people actively trying random fixes. those feel really different

guide v3 is up. new state *stalled-after-error*: an error or failed test in the last 60s AND no edit or run for ≥45s of the window AND no help request. "stuck" is now only for active-but-unproductive (edits/runs that don't change the error). pdf attached, gdoc updated too
